strict_default_parity.method: Load original HEAD parser via git show into a separate in-memory Python module; compare full outputs or typed refusal codes with current default on seven synthetic valid/invalid fixtures.

controls.opaque_clean_parity: Clean CP950 source using explicit opaque profile has identical financial output to original parser, except explicit source_decoding metadata.
controls.allowance: Only reversible CP950 surrogate transport; exact allowed standards-note namespace and local name; exact name/contextRef/escape=true attributes; matching valid entity/context period; only isolated invalid 0x84 bytes; global maximum32. Note body never becomes output.
refusals: Unbound or wrong QName/namespace, extra attributes or non-exact escape
Opaque note nested under ix:header/ix:hidden/ix:resources/selected or unselected IX numeric/nonNumeric ancestors or XBRLI resources
Any child markup before or after invalid bytes; unclosed note
Invalid bytes outside approved body or wrong undecodable byte
Invalid bytes inside unselected numeric suffix; later duplicate resource ID
controls.individual_profile: Explicit individual profile accepts only matching REPORT_ID=A, with source report id A and limited statement_basis; consolidation remains NOT_PROVEN_BY_CONTEXT_OR_QUERY. Default consolidated profile refuses A, individual profile refuses C, and entity mismatch yields no financial facts.
controls.existing_unittest_coverage: 31 executed tests also cover later duplicate numerical conflicts and namespace rebindings, whole-receipt hash/size binding, CLI explicit choices, selected-fact/resource strictness, nil/sign/scale/unit/YTD rejection and source admission false.

conclusions.explanation: Fugle institutional-trades and official TWSE per-security TWT86UC/TWTAIUC expose shares; BFI82U/BFIBGU expose institutional-category market totals. None of these inspected sources provides the per-security actual institutional TWD required by V1. Source normalization, re-fetching or multiplying shares by close cannot supply that missing measurement.

Official Finnhub EPS/revenue model averages include provider proprietary estimates and inspected model fields do not establish revision vintage, currency or share-class measurement. A current retrieval cannot establish pre-announcement first-seen availability. Dedicated PIT products exist, but TW72 coverage, account entitlement, comparable accounting and reuse rights remain unverified.

The local frozen Universe contains domestic numeric symbols. TSMC issuer disclosures distinguish local-currency ordinary-share EPS from USD ADR EPS and a five-ordinary-shares-per-ADR ratio. No general mapping or currency/scale conversion for all 72 issuers is proved by this example.

On unchanged prepatch evaluator, a complete four-quarter mixed beat/miss fixture is reported as missing fundamental evidence. The criterion-completeness distinction can be fixed without declaring mixed history intact or weakening selection thresholds. This synthetic reproduction does not establish the reason for the saved Production 72-stock snapshot.

V2 uses institutional SHARES, actual revenue and measured price/relative strength with consensus_required=false; complete NONE is a valid evaluation. Entry defines independent reversal/pullback/breakout research hypotheses. Neither constitutes V1 input repair, guaranteed daily READY, research promotion or public publication approval.
